items.prompt:
A high melting point suggests the forces between particles are
A) strong
B) weak
C) absent
D) random

steps: Strong forces give high melting points.

items.prompt:
A low melting point suggests the forces between particles are
A) strong
B) weak
C) infinite
D) made of light

steps: Weak forces give low melting points.

items.prompt:
To conduct electricity, a substance needs ____ that can move.
A) charged particles
B) color
C) light
D) sound

Substance A melts at 800 C and B at 20 C. Which has stronger particle forces?
A) A
B) B
C) They are equal
D) Neither has forces

steps: A needs more energy to melt, so stronger forces.

items.prompt:
A solid conducts electricity only after it is melted. This suggests it is made of
A) charged particles locked in place until melted
B) only light
C) no particles
D) pure metal gas
items.answer: A) charged particles locked in place until melted

steps: Melting frees the charged particles to move.

items.prompt:
Ionic solids usually have ____ melting points.
A) high
B) low
C) no
D) negative

steps: Ionic solids have strong forces and high melting points.

items.prompt:
A substance that melts at a very high temperature most likely has
A) strong forces between its particles
B) weak forces
C) no particles
D) no forces
items.answer: A) strong forces between its particles

steps: A very high melting point means strong forces.

items.prompt:
The best evidence to compare particle forces in two substances is
A) their melting points, boiling points, and conductivity
B) their color only
C) their names
D) their price
items.answer: A) their melting points, boiling points, and conductivity

steps: These bulk properties reveal the particle forces.
